Title: Creates a true cost of economic security study
Summary: Creates a true cost of economic security study to measure how much income and other resources are needed for a family of a given composition in a given geographic location to adequately meet a comprehensive set of regular household costs, set aside savings both for future planning and for short-term emergencies, and manage debt.
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the social services law, in relation to the creation of a true cost of economic security study
